note: Arab Bank Jordan: a minimum balance fee of 1 dinar a month on a current account whose balance is below 100 dinars (payroll accounts excepted, not modelled).

sources.title: Arab Bank (Jordan), Retail Fees and Charges
sources.said: Minimum Balance fees (Salary, Current, or Savings Accounts) JD 1 per month for balances below JD 100 (Except for payroll accounts)
